name: High Knees
research: Running on the spot; no props (loose fists, thumbs up). Root raised 0.029 to z 1.000 (on the ball of the stance foot), hips at z ~1.003. Picture 1, left knee up: hip flexion 80 (S1: ~80 deg in sprint swing; S2: hip height is enough), knee 90. Thigh dir (0, -sin80, -cos80) = (0, -0.985, -0.174) -> knee = hip (0.11, 0.005, 1.003) + 0.45 x = (0.12, -0.438, 0.925); shin square to the thigh, pointing down and slightly back (0, 0.174, -0.985) -> ankle = (0.12, -0.36, 0.482); check hip-ankle = 0.636 = 0.45 x sqrt2 (90 deg knee). Knee pole forward and up (0.14, -1.2, 1.0). Stance right foot on its ball: heel up 25 deg (rot X +25 = toes down); ball offset (0, -0.14, -0.06) rotates to z -0.113 -> ankle z = 0.014 + 0.113 = 0.127; hip-ankle 0.876 -> knee ~25 deg. Arms pump opposite to the legs: forward arm elev 50, plane 90, elbow 90 folding up (bend +z); back arm elev 35, plane -90, elbow 90 folding forward. Fist axes square to each forearm, thumb up: forward forearm (0, 0.643, 0.766) -> axis (0, -0.766, 0.643); back forearm (0, 0.819, -0.574) -> axis (0, 0.574, 0.819). Picture 2 mirrors.
